{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

Removes the background from every picture in a folder in one Run, and saves two versions of each: a transparent PNG for design work, and a JPG on plain white, the way online shops want product photos.

 Pick your folder

  1. On Load Images from Folder Pixaroma, click Browse and pick your folder, or paste the folder's path into the box.
  2. Click Pick images, then Select all, or click only the pictures you want. The button shows how many are picked.
  3. Press Run once. Leave the Run count at 1: the node sends every picture through by itself, one after the other.

This workflow opens with no folder picked: choose your own folder, or try it first on the demo folder Products inside the Media Inputs folder that comes with these workflows.

 A folder inside ComfyUI's own input or output folder works straight away. A folder anywhere else works too, but pick it once with Browse: that is how ComfyUI knows you allowed it.

 Pictures go through in name order. Name them 01_, 02_ and so on if the order matters.

 Options

  • Only want one version? Click the Save node you do not need and press Ctrl+M to mute it.
  • Hair and fur: BiRefNet also comes as a matting model that keeps fine edges better. The help of Remove Background Pixaroma (the ? on its toolbar) names it.
  • Another background colour: change the colour number on EmptyImage. It is the hex colour as a number: white is 16777215, black is 0.

 How long it takes

4 product photos took 2.1 s on a 4090, model already loaded. BiRefNet is small (444 MB), so this runs on almost any graphics card.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Load Images from Folder Pixaroma (1. your folder) - Point it at a folder and pick the pictures. Press Run once and it sends every picture through the workflow, one after the other. Its filename output carries each picture's name to the save node, and index says which picture it is (1, 2, 3 ...).

 The helpers

Purple. They run by themselves and do the small jobs: count, pick, join or pass things along.

  • Get Image Size (of each picture) - Reads the width and height of each picture, so the white background is made at the same size.
  • EmptyImage (white background) - A plain white picture at the size of each original. The colour 16777215 is white; type another number for another colour.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • Remove Background Pixaroma (cuts out the subject) - Finds the subject with the BiRefNet model and cuts it out. Its image output is the cut-out with a transparent background, its mask output is white where the subject is.
  • ImageCompositeMasked (picture on white) - Puts the original picture on the white background, using the mask so only the subject is kept.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Save Image Pixaroma (transparent PNG) - Saves the cut-outs as PNG with a transparent background into ComfyUI/output/No Background, with the original names.
  • Save Image Pixaroma (white background JPG) - Saves the same subjects on white as JPG into ComfyUI/output/White Background: the shop-ready version.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.
